name: @memory-river/adapter-mcp

tools.name: memory_recall
tools.description: Search long-term memory for relevant facts, summaries, and source provenance.

tools.name: memory_rehydrate
tools.description: Read exact original conversation turns. Prefer entry_ids with relevant sourceEntryIds and their sessionKey; use time_range for a trustworthy timestamp; use one distinctive keyword when recall failed.

tools.name: memory_archive
tools.description: Archive host conversation messages into the exact transcript store for later rehydration.

tools.name: memory_update
tools.description: Update the text, category, importance, or metadata of an existing memory by id.

tools.name: memory_set_status
tools.description: Change a memory status to deprecated, superseded, trashed, or active to restore it.

tools.name: gwm_on
tools.description: Start Global Working Memory for a task so its keywords bias recall.

tools.name: gwm_status
tools.description: Show the current Global Working Memory task and drift state.

tools.name: gwm_update
tools.description: Update the Global Working Memory task name, description, or keywords.

tools.name: skill_load
tools.description: Load a saved skill's full execution steps by name.

tools.name: memory_river_info
tools.description: Report the adapter version and available capabilities.
